content: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions v1.41.0 (Development) require gen_ai.operation.name and gen_ai.provider.name on an inference span; gen_ai.request.model is conditionally required when available. Prompt and completion content (gen_ai.input.messages, gen_ai.output.messages, gen_ai.system_instructions) are Opt-In. Official Python OpenAI instrumentation does not capture message content unless OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT is set. Token counts and temperature are Recommended, not required. Source: https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/blob/v1.41.0/docs/gen-ai/gen-ai-spans.md
